items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: No, I haven't seen him for a long time.

ctx.x: That's what I heard of, that he was down to Mexico or something. I haven't seen him for over ten years.
No, I haven't seen him for a long time. And, you know, he's...Bill is where?
Oh, he's about 86 or 87, I believe now.
